The real mountain at 1:1 scale from USGS elevation data: 30 lifts, 124 named runs, 2,850 vertical feet. Carve it, tuck it, send the cliffs, ride the chair back up.

Controls

A D · ← →
Steer. Hold a turn and the edges bite: the carve tightens and scrubs less speed. In the air they spin you
W · ↑
Tuck for speed on snow. Front flip in the air
S · ↓
Brake: throw the skis sideways for a hockey stop. Back flip in the air
Shift
Pole and skate across the flats
Space
Hold to crouch, release to pop. In the air, hold for a tail grab
Q · E · C · F
Japan, nose, indy and safety grabs in the air
E
Load a lift when you are at its bottom station
F · Enter
On a lift: hold F to fast-forward, Enter to skip to the top
V
Chase camera / helmet camera. Drag the mouse to look around
M
Trail map. Click any lift to travel to it
1 2 3 4
Bluebird, golden hour, flat light, snowing
R · P · N
Stand back up where you are · pause · mute
